Add excel-shrink workspace, core and cli crates

Introduce a new Rust workspace for excel-shrink with two crates: excel-shrink-core (library) and excel-shrink-cli (command-line). Core implements XML/stylesheet parsing and streaming sheet cleaning (error types, models, styles, sheet processing, workbook helpers and tests). CLI provides a clap-based binary, file gathering, and a pipeline that loads XLSX ZIPs into memory, extracts and cleans worksheet XML (optional parallel CPU processing), and writes results via an async writer pool. Also add workspace Cargo.toml, crate manifests, VSCode launch/tasks configs, and Cargo.lock.
